    """Returns priority with which we want to add item to each bin.
    Args:
        item: Size of item to be added to the bin.
        bins: Array of capacities for each bin.
    Return:
        Array of same size as bins with priority score of each bin.
    """
    rem = bins - item
    scores = np.full_like(bins, -np.inf, dtype=float)
    fit = (rem >= 0)
    if not np.any(fit):
        return scores
    
    max_cap = np.max(bins) if len(bins) > 0 else 1.0
    empty_mask = (bins == max_cap) & fit
    non_empty_fit = fit & ~empty_mask
    
    if np.any(non_empty_fit):
        scores[non_empty_fit] = -np.exp(rem[non_empty_fit])
        
    if np.any(empty_mask):
        first_empty = np.argmax(empty_mask)
        scores[first_empty] = -np.exp(max_cap) * 2.0
        
    return scores

    """Returns priority with which we want to add item to each bin.
    Args:
        item: Size of item to be added to the bin.
        bins: Array of capacities for each bin.
    Return:
        Array of same size as bins with priority score of each bin.
    """
    rem = bins - item
    scores = np.full_like(bins, -np.inf, dtype=float)
    fit = rem >= 0
    if not np.any(fit):
        return scores
    max_cap = np.max(bins) if len(bins) > 0 else 1.0
    used_mask = bins < max_cap
    avg_fill = np.mean(max_cap - bins[used_mask]) if np.any(used_mask) else 0.0
    
    # Harmonic scoring for feasible bins
    scores[fit] = 1.0 / (1.0 + rem[fit]) + (1.0 - (rem[fit] / max_cap)) * (avg_fill / max_cap)
    
    # Handle empty bins uniquely using an entropy-inspired cost
    empty_mask = (bins == max_cap) & fit
    if np.any(empty_mask):
        first_empty = np.argmax(empty_mask)
        num_bins = len(bins)
        num_used = np.sum(used_mask)
        fragmentation_penalty = 0.5 * (num_used / max(1, num_bins))
        scores[first_empty] = 0.5 - fragmentation_penalty
        
    return scores

    """Returns priority with which we want to add item to each bin.
    Args:
        item: Size of item to be added to the bin.
        bins: Array of capacities for each bin.
    Return:
        Array of same size as bins with priority score of each bin.
    """
    rem = bins - item
    scores = np.full_like(bins, -np.inf, dtype=float)
    fit = rem >= 0
    if not np.any(fit):
        return scores
    
    max_cap = np.max(bins) if len(bins) > 0 else 1.0
    empty_mask = (bins == max_cap) & fit
    non_empty_fit = fit & ~empty_mask
    
    if np.any(non_empty_fit):
        used_capacity = max_cap - bins[non_empty_fit]
        item_ratio = item / max_cap
        # Harmonic-like scoring favoring tight fits and high fractional occupancy
        scores[non_empty_fit] = used_capacity / (rem[non_empty_fit] + 1e-5) + item_ratio * (max_cap / (rem[non_empty_fit] + 1e-5))
        
    if np.any(empty_mask):
        first_empty = np.argmax(empty_mask)
        num_bins = len(bins)
        active_bins = np.sum(bins < max_cap)
